rule.name: WeakHmac
rule.message: Sign with HMAC-SHA256: Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256") (or Hashing.hmacSha256, HmacAlgorithms.HMAC_SHA_256). HMAC-SHA1 stays allowed where a protocol fixes it; HMAC-MD5 is not.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'getInstance'][*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('javax.crypto.Mac')]] [ArgumentList/*[1][let $name := self::VariableAccess/@Name return (string(@ConstValue), //VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $name]/StringLiteral/@ConstValue) [matches(., '^hmac(md2|md4|md5)$', 'i')]]] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'hmacMd5'][*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('com.google.common.hash.Hashing')]] | //MethodCall[starts-with(@MethodName, 'hmacMd5') or @MethodName = 'getHmacMd5'] [*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.codec.digest.HmacUtils')]] | //*[self::FieldAccess or self::VariableAccess][@Name = 'HMAC_MD5'] [pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.codec.digest.HmacAlgorithms')] | //ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('org.bouncycastle.crypto.macs.HMac')] [ArgumentList/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('org.bouncycastle.crypto.digests.MD5Digest') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.bouncycastle.crypto.digests.MD4Digest') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.bouncycastle.crypto.digests.MD2Digest')]]
